after: ## The internet: fast global access to information
alt: Gatekeeping has moved from newspaper editors to search engines and recommendation systems, so attention becomes scarce. Castells’s network society and mass self-communication sit below.
caption: Algorithms have replaced editors as the main filters of what people see.

alt: boyd’s four features of networked publics: persistence, visibility, spreadability and searchability. Below, family, friends, teachers and employers collapse into one audience for a single online self, with Turkle’s isolation argument and a reply.
caption: Online, posts last and spread, and separate audiences collapse into one.

after: ## Social media and mental health: evaluating the evidence
alt: Mechanisms by which social media might harm young people, from Twenge and others, set against methodological problems such as correlation, inaccurate self-reports, reverse causation and crude screen-time measures.
caption: Plausible mechanisms, but weak evidence of universal harm.

after: ## Ownership and control of new and social media
alt: A platform sits between users, advertisers and producers, and network effects favour a few giants (Srnicek). Zuboff’s chain turns users’ behaviour into data that predicts and influences behaviour and is sold to advertisers. Marxist and pluralist readings and the Cambridge Analytica case follow.
caption: Platforms profit from their position between groups and from users’ data.

alt: Pariser’s filter bubble, Sunstein’s echo chambers and the finding that false news spreads faster, set against Bruns’s argument that strong filter bubbles are weakly supported and Uscinski and Parent’s century of conspiracy talk.
caption: Algorithms amplify falsehood, but people choose what to share.

after: ## Audience involvement: creators, citizen journalists, influencers
alt: Three forms of audience involvement: prosumers and produsers, citizen journalists in Tunisia, Egypt and Minneapolis, and influencers as microcelebrities. Evaluation from Morozov, Gladwell and the economics of platforms.
caption: Audiences now produce content, but power and profit stay uneven.
